summary.en: Models RAN channels, control/user-plane state and link bandwidth/latency; routers use shortest-path forwarding. This is not a full wire-protocol implementation.
summary.zh: 建模 RAN 信道、控制面与用户面状态及链路带宽、时延；路由器采用最短路径转发，不是完整线上协议实现。

note.en: Models RAN channels, control/user-plane state and link bandwidth/latency; routers use shortest-path forwarding. This is not a full wire-protocol implementation.
note.zh: 建模 RAN 信道、控制面与用户面状态及链路带宽、时延；路由器采用最短路径转发，不是完整线上协议实现。

summary.en: An ndnSIM/NFD extension models named-function execution using a Kernel Store for unikernel images. The documented cloud-node mode adds network delay and treats CPU resources as unlimited.
summary.zh: ndnSIM/NFD 扩展，通过保存 unikernel 镜像的 Kernel Store 建模具名函数执行；文档中的云节点模式增加网络时延，并将 CPU 资源视为无限。

note.en: The documented NFaaS branch extends ndnSIM/NFD with named-function execution; it does not inherit every protocol of a newer ns-3 release.
note.zh: NFaaS 文档分支在 ndnSIM/NFD 上扩展命名函数执行，不继承新版 ns-3 的全部协议。

summary.en: Packet-level Internet and wireless models. Built-in models and separately installed extensions are listed separately; each model implements a defined subset of its standard.
summary.zh: 分组级互联网与无线网络模型。内置模型与需另行安装的扩展分别列出；各模型实现相应标准中明确界定的部分。

note.en: Internet-stack models at the pinned source revision; install the appropriate stack and NetDevice in the scenario.
note.zh: 固定提交中的互联网协议栈模型；场景需安装对应协议栈与网络设备。

note.en: Ping covers IPv4/IPv6. DHCP client/server models have documented message and relay limitations; consult the selected model.
note.zh: Ping 覆盖 IPv4/IPv6；DHCP 客户端与服务器模型有报文及中继限制，需查看对应模型说明。

note.en: Routing choices include MANET, distance-vector, static and centrally computed global routes. Global routing does not implement OSPF message exchange.
note.zh: 路由选项包括 MANET、距离向量、静态及集中计算的全局路由；全局路由不实现 OSPF 报文交换。

note.en: The pinned guide lists a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be PHY, EDCA and mesh models. Standard coverage is partial: For example, beamforming and PCF/HCCA are excluded in this revision.
note.zh: 固定提交手册列出 a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be PHY、EDCA 及 Mesh 模型。标准覆盖有边界，例如该版本不包含波束成形和 PCF/HCCA。

note.en: Ethernet-style framing on a simplified shared channel; the model does not reproduce every IEEE 802.3 PHY or collision behavior.
note.zh: 简化共享信道上的以太网式帧模型，不复现 IEEE 802.3 的全部物理层和冲突行为。

note.en: Separate point-to-point device and Nix-vector routing modules are included in the model catalog.
note.zh: 模型目录包含独立的点到点设备及 Nix-vector 路由模块。

note.en: LTE models RRC, PDCP, RLC, MAC and PHY; EPC models core entities and interfaces. The guide specifies the fidelity and omissions of each layer.
note.zh: LTE 建模 RRC、PDCP、RLC、MAC 与 PHY；EPC 建模核心网实体与接口，各层精度和省略项以手册为准。

note.en: LR-WPAN supports beacon/non-beacon operation, slotted/unslotted CSMA/CA and scan/association within the documented PHY/MAC subset.
note.zh: LR-WPAN 在文档界定的 PHY/MAC 范围内支持信标与非信标、时隙与非时隙 CSMA/CA、扫描与关联。

note.en: IPv6 adaptation with the documented compression, fragmentation and neighbor-discovery capabilities; configure a compatible underlying NetDevice.
note.zh: IPv6 适配层，包含文档中的压缩、分片及邻居发现功能，需配置兼容的底层网络设备。

note.en: Research model with NWK/APS and limited ZDO functionality in this revision. Security, ZCL and the application framework are outside its implemented scope.
note.zh: 该提交提供 NWK/APS 与有限 ZDO 功能的研究模型，不包含安全机制、ZCL 和应用框架。

note.en: UAN provides acoustic PHY, channel and MAC abstractions; this tag identifies the underwater network model family, not a wire protocol.
note.zh: UAN 提供水声 PHY、信道及 MAC 抽象；该标签表示水下网络模型家族，并非一个线上协议。

note.en: The OpenFlow switch module requires a separately built compatible OFSID library. It is not enabled by an ordinary ns-3 build alone.
note.zh: OpenFlow 交换模块要求另行编译兼容的 OFSID 库，普通 ns-3 构建不会单独提供这项集成。

note.en: Install CTTC 5G-LENA separately and follow its ns-3 version matrix (for example, 5G-LENA 5.1 with ns-3.48). This is not a bundled ns-3 module.
note.zh: 需另行安装 CTTC 5G-LENA，并遵循其 ns-3 版本对应表，例如 5G-LENA 5.1 对应 ns-3.48；它不是 ns-3 自带模块。

note.en: Install the signetlabdei LoRaWAN module separately; use the compatible ns-3 revision specified by that module.
note.zh: 需另行安装 signetlabdei 的 LoRaWAN 模块，并采用该模块指定的兼容 ns-3 版本。

note.en: The TCP guide documents selectable congestion-control implementations. Select the required SocketType; a TCP tag does not imply that all algorithms run simultaneously.
note.zh: TCP 手册记录可选择的拥塞控制实现；需选择所需 SocketType，TCP 标签不表示同时运行所有算法。
